name: Pim Tallowby
appearance: Short and round-cheeked, with freckles, brown hair in a flour-dusted braid and a tiny copper bell in one ear.
sketch: A chatty, curious baker's apprentice who is always slightly behind and mostly forgiven.

wants.text: to keep everything exactly as it is

fear: Being the reason something goes wrong.
flaw: She says yes to everything, then panics.

values.text: caring for the people she feeds

behaviors.tendency: go quiet and tidy everything in reach

competence: Can tell the weather by how dough rises.
vulnerability: She cannot say no to anyone who asks kindly.
speech: Chatty and quick, trailing off into questions.

name: Orla Fennick
appearance: Tall and wiry, with cropped white hair and forearms scarred from the oven.
sketch: A gruff, fair master baker who shows rather than tells.

wants.text: to carry on exactly as she always has

flaw: She will not explain anything she cannot show by doing.
competence: Reads fire and heat by feel.
vulnerability: She cannot bear being thought past it.
history: Has fired the same oven every morning for forty years.

name: Corbin Reeds
appearance: Lanky, with ink-stained thumbs, a sunburnt neck and a feathered hat he is very proud of.
sketch: A delighted wanderer who maps the world but never stays in it.
flaw: He leaves before things get hard.
competence: Draws a true map from a single walk.
vulnerability: He cannot resist an unexplored road.
speech: Talks a lot and wanders off mid-sentence.
history: Has spent ten years walking from valley to valley.
